patch_description: This replaces the state-space Kalman tracker with a causal multiscale robust local-polynomial regression filter. At every sample it fits endpoint-aligned quadratic models over both a short and long trailing window, using exponentially weighted samples and Huber residual reweighting to suppress impulsive noise. The short model preserves fast dynamics while the longer model stabilizes low-frequency trend tracking. Their blend is passed through a continuous soft slope-shrinkage stage, rather than a hard reversal gate, reducing small noise-driven directional flips without delaying genuine large movements.
